summary: Room Finish Schedule Visual Wall Diagram feature fully tested - all backend API tests (11/11) and frontend UI tests (9/9) passed. The P0 bugs from previous iteration have been fixed: SVG grout lines are now thick (5px) and clearly visible, pattern picker shows all 8 patterns.
critical_code_review_comments: PatternOverlay component uses thick grout lines (5px main + 7px shadow) for maximum visibility
Unique SVG pattern IDs prevent collisions when multiple zones have the same pattern
Pattern picker shows all 8 patterns in a 4x2 grid with SVG thumbnails
Material palette shows actual tile images from room items with green ring selection indicator
Wall diagram has 6 zones: Ceiling, Upper/Accent, Main Wall, Chair Rail/Stool, Wainscot/Curb, Floor
Compact label bar at bottom of each zone shows material name, vendor, size, and pattern
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test project with 4 tile items (Black & White Basket Weave, Calacatta Gold Marble, Subway Tile White Gloss, Hexagon Carrara)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Room Finish Schedule Visual Wall Diagram feature is complete. Key features verified: 1) Material palette shows tile images from room items, 2) Clicking tile selects it (green ring), 3) Clicking wall zone places tile with background texture, 4) SVG grout lines render over tile images with thick visible lines, 5) PATTERN button on hover opens picker with all 8 patterns, 6) Measurement canvas with draw/select modes works. The Back Wall surface has 3 materials: Main Wall=Herringbone, Wainscot=Offset, Floor=Stacked Horizontal.
